topPick.thesis: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) is trading at 15.0x P/E, a 13% discount to its sector average of 17.2x; RSI at 59 reflects healthy bullish momentum without overextension. Three-month price momentum of +53.1% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +348% year-on-year, underpinned by a bullish MACD crossover confirming upward price pressure. Composite score of 81/100 places MPC in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +36.2% over the past quarter.
